# dist/  (OUTPUT — generated by the Workflow)

Converted, sitegen-ready blocks land here, one subfolder per page:

```
dist/
├── home/        block-01-hero.html, block-02-trustbar.html, …
├── vaughan/     (priority page; built after home)
├── aurora/      (transform of vaughan)
├── lg/          (brand reference page)
├── samsung/  whirlpool/  bosch/  kitchenaid/   (transforms of lg)
├── about-us/  contact/  warranty/
└── privacy-policy/  terms-and-conditions/  cancellation-policy/
```

Block files are named `block-NN-name.html`, ids sequential (`block-01-hero`, …),
each self-contained so it survives being pasted into sitegen on its own.
